mainEntity.name: How Do You Choose a Palletizing System?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose by line speed, case weight and floor space. TRFCobot covers about 1 to 10 cases per minute with cases up to about 22 lb, TRFCompact about 5 to 15 cases per minute up to about 44 lb, and TRFSpeed about 10 to 35 cases per minute up to about 66 lb. TRFSubzero covers palletizing areas below 32°F. TRF engineering confirms the final capacity for each application.

mainEntity.name: Can a Palletizer Be Integrated With My Existing Conveyor and Wrapping Line?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. TRF engineers palletizing, case packing and conveying as one end-of-line system, supported from Lenexa, Kansas. TRFSpeed is built to work with conveyors, accumulation, pallet handling, slip sheets, wrapping, labeling and warehouse interfaces, and end-of-line integration puts one partner in charge of the whole flow from case packer to pallet.

mainEntity.name: Who Makes Robotic Case Palletizers With Local Support in the US?

acceptedAnswer.text: TRF designs, builds, installs and supports robotic palletizers for manufacturers across the United States. The family covers TRFCobot, TRFCompact, TRFSpeed and TRFSubzero, plus a custom palletizer for products or layouts outside the standard ranges. How TRF supports its equipment after startup, including spare parts, is described on the Parts and Service page.
